name: ticketing-back
description: Backend for Gatewav Ticketing - auth, memberships, organizer flow

scripts.db:schema: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const url = process.env.DATABASE_URL; if (!url) { console.error('DATABASE_URL required'); process.exit(1); } execSync(`psql '${url}' -f db/schema.sql', { stdio: 'inherit' });"
